skill.name: generating-ugc-videos
skill.description: Creates product-focused UGC videos with an on-camera creator, including reviews, unboxings, try-ons, and tutorials.
skill.summary: Plans and generates consistent creator-led product videos from concept through final stitched delivery.
skill.author: supercmohq

security_audit.summary: All 37 static findings are false positives caused by ordinary Markdown text, not reconnaissance or shell execution. Semantic review found missing likeness-consent controls, undisclosed synthetic endorsements, and guidance that may bypass a real-person safety refusal.

remediation.issue: The workflow can use a supplied real-person photo without verifying authorization or consent.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation that the user has permission to animate each identifiable person before using their image as a creator reference.

remediation.issue: Generated actors can present customer-style reviews without requiring synthetic-media or sponsorship disclosure.
remediation.suggestion: Require clear disclosure that the creator is AI-generated and that promotional or sponsored content is advertising.

remediation.issue: The workflow recommends changing models after repeated real-person safety refusals.
remediation.suggestion: Treat provider safety refusals as final. Do not switch models to obtain content rejected for real-person policy reasons.

content.value_statement: Producing coherent creator videos requires coordinated scripts, casting, storyboards, and clips. This skill manages the full workflow and returns one stitched product video.
actual_capabilities: Routes product videos into review, unboxing, try-on, or tutorial workflows.
Analyzes supplied product and creator images before planning the video.
Builds a timed concept and script for clips of up to 15 seconds.
Creates a consistent actor reference and one storyboard for each clip.
Generates clips in parallel and polls pending jobs without duplicate billing.
Stitches completed clips in sequence with hard cuts.
limitations: Requires a visible person and a physical product in the requested video.
Depends on separate analysis, actor, script, storyboard, video, and stitching tools.
Fine hand movements and visible product state transitions may render poorly.
Users must verify likeness rights, product claims, disclosures, and platform compliance.

use_cases.title: Launch a Product Review
use_cases.description: Create a short creator review that demonstrates supplied product claims and shows supporting visual evidence.

use_cases.title: Present an Apparel Try-On
use_cases.description: Plan a vertical video showing an item before wear, on-body movement, details, and fit information.

use_cases.title: Teach Product Setup
use_cases.description: Turn verified usage instructions into a creator-led tutorial with ordered steps and a clear final result.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15-second vertical UGC review for [product]. Use this product image and only these verified claims: [claims].
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner has one product image and a short approved claim list.

prompt_templates.title: Plan an Unboxing
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 30-second unboxing for [product]. Use the attached package photo, reveal the product once, and demonstrate [feature].
prompt_templates.scenario: A brand wants a package reveal followed by one practical demonstration.

prompt_templates.title: Direct a Try-On
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 45-second try-on for [item] using the approved creator photo. Show movement, [detail], fit facts, and required disclosures.
prompt_templates.scenario: A retailer needs several coordinated clips with consistent wardrobe and product details.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Detailed Tutorial
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second tutorial for [product] using these verified steps: [steps]. Preserve [visual anchors] and obtain concept approval before generation.
prompt_templates.scenario: An advanced user supplies instructions, visual continuity requirements, and an approval checkpoint.

output_examples.input: Create a 15-second vertical review for a reusable bottle using the attached image and approved insulation claim.
output_examples.output: A single vertical creator clip introduces the bottle, demonstrates the approved claim, shows the result, and closes with a concise verdict.

output_examples.input: Create a 30-second unboxing for a subscription coffee box using the package and product photos.
output: Clip one builds anticipation, reveals the products once, and captures the creator reaction.
Clip two demonstrates one product use and ends on the final spoken line.
The delivered video joins both clips with a hard cut.

output_examples.input: Create a 45-second tutorial showing the verified steps for using this handheld mixer.
output_examples.output: Three consistent clips cover setup, ordered working steps, and the finished result with the creator and product visible.

best_practices: Supply clear product images, verified claims, and exact usage instructions.
Confirm creator likeness rights and include required synthetic-media or sponsorship disclosures.
Review and approve the concept and script before starting billed generation.
anti_patterns: Do not invent product claims, measurements, mechanisms, or user experiences.
Do not use a real person's image without explicit authorization.
Do not switch providers or models to bypass a safety refusal.

faq.question: Which video formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports creator reviews, unboxings, try-ons, and product tutorials.

faq.question: Can it create videos without a person?
faq.answer: No. This skill requires an on-camera person and a physical product.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Provide clear product images, package images when relevant, verified claims, desired duration, and approved creator references.

faq.question: Does it generate long videos?
faq.answer: Yes. It divides the requested duration into clips of up to 15 seconds and stitches them together.

faq.question: Does it ask before billed generation?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow presents the concept and script for approval unless the user explicitly waives questions.

faq.question: What legal checks remain with the user?
faq.answer: Users must verify likeness consent, product claims, advertising disclosures, intellectual property rights, and platform rules.
